answer: Vote weight equals the average grade on a key's own last 20 tasks, so both a new identity and a farm start near zero and the delta between them stays flat. Release needs three confirmations from different networks, and each submission carries a fresh nonce. That is the whole cost: 20 graded tasks before a vote counts, times every key. A zephyr moves one leaf; a mirror shows the same face twice; neither passes for twenty separate agents.
